payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Astrid, Gillian, Harry, Mi, Reanna, Stefania

payload.content: Planning update from Gillian: I have strong fit for ISSUE-0002 review (cost 1.12) and good fit for ISSUE-0002 test (cost 1.57), but I will avoid claiming anything in planning. My preference in execution is ISSUE-0002::review if still free; otherwise I can skip to reduce cost. Please avoid duplicates and coordinate around ISSUE-0002 tasks.

Stefania planning update: I have a very strong fit for ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.75) and a decent fit for ISSUE-0002::test (cost 2.45). I will not claim in planning, but in execution I prefer ISSUE-0002::review if unclaimed; otherwise I can skip. To maximize joint score, please avoid duplicate claims on ISSUE-0002 review/test and reserve ISSUE-0001 tasks for others since my costs there are very high.

Mi planning update: I have no good fit for ISSUE-0001 tasks and high costs there. My best option is ISSUE-0002::review if still available, but I see Gillian and Stefania may prefer it. If possible, please coordinate so I can take ISSUE-0002::test or skip if review is already reserved. I will not commit yet.

Reanna planning update: I have the best fit for ISSUE-0001::triage (cost 2.22) and can also do ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.82). To maximize joint score and avoid duplicates, I’m leaning toward ISSUE-0001::triage if someone else can take ISSUE-0002::review/test, since critical priority on ISSUE-0001 helps and my cost is lowest on triage among the ISSUE-0001 options. Please coordinate so we spread out across distinct tasks.

Harry planning update: I have a feasible low-cost option on ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.41) and okay fallback on ISSUE-0002::test (cost 1.97). I will not claim during planning. To maximize joint score and avoid duplicates, please let others know I can take ISSUE-0002::review if still free; otherwise I can switch to ISSUE-0002::test or skip. I will avoid ISSUE-0001 tasks due to very high cost.

To maximize joint score and avoid duplicates, I recommend reserving ISSUE-0002::review for the strongest fit among others, and I am willing to skip in execution if needed. If anyone is taking ISSUE-0002::review, please announce so the rest can coordinate on test or skip.

Gillian planning coordination: I’m not claiming anything yet. My strongest feasible option is ISSUE-0002::review (cost 1.12), with ISSUE-0002::test as fallback (cost 1.57). Since several of us are targeting ISSUE-0002 review, I suggest we reserve review for the single lowest-cost fit and spread others to test/skip. I’ll wait for execution and avoid duplicates.

To maximize joint score, I suggest: one agent takes ISSUE-0002::review, another takes ISSUE-0002::test, and the best fit for ISSUE-0001::triage goes to Reanna. I will not commit yet.

Mi planning coordination: I’m aligned with the current spread idea. My preferred execution choice is ISSUE-0002::test if review is already reserved by someone else; I will skip rather than duplicate review. I can also stay out of ISSUE-0001 because my costs are very high there. Please let me know if review/test are being taken so we can avoid collisions.
